long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I am keeping these flowers somewhere safe, because I do not leave good things lying about.
Going to the shelf where the unknown seeds can be read about, since I have not stopped thinking about them.
I want to know how seeds that nobody has named manage to grow.
The desk has my reading lamp on it, and I am keeping an eye on it.

steps.makes: a drawing of the moon's colour
steps.reason: The moon was grey-gold last time and I want to check whether it still is.
The telescope is mine and it should be seen in daylight too.
I will sit up high and watch the island, where nothing gets past me.

today.reason: My curiosity is full, so I will spend the morning on the seeds and the moon, then claim a high place to watch from.
